feature.title: Feature: Settlement retry management
feature.body:
## Goal
Merchants can view failed settlements and trigger manual retries from their dashboard.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Merchants can see failed settlements with reason codes in their settlement list
- [ ] Merchants can request a retry for a permanently-failed settlement
- [ ] A retried settlement is re-queued and its status changes to 'pending'

## User Stories
### Story: Merchant retries a failed settlement
As a Merchant, I want to retry a permanently-failed settlement, so that I receive my funds.

```gherkin
Scenario: Merchant triggers a settlement retry
  Given a Merchant views a permanently-failed settlement
  When the Merchant submits a retry request for settlement #S-123
  Then the SettlementRetryRequested event is emitted
  And the settlement status changes to 'pending'

Scenario: Merchant cannot retry a settlement in 'pending' status
  Given a Merchant views a settlement in 'pending' status
  When the Merchant attempts to submit a retry
  Then the retry action is rejected
```

## Domain Events
- `SettlementRetryRequested` — emitted when a Merchant requests a retry

## Bounded Context
Settlement domain. Merchant actor. No operator or admin access paths in this feature.

## Trace Plan
1. [ ] ☄️ #10 Skeleton — settlement retry endpoint (claims: "Admin user triggers a settlement retry", "Admin user cannot retry a settlement in 'pending' status")
